assets.label: pressure relief devices
assets.service: overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system

control_failures.control_label: classification of a space and issue of an entry permit
atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work
standby attendance and non-entry rescue capability

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: uncontrolled movement of PSV-4111 during shift handover

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control CONFINED_SPACE_ENTRY_PERMIT: the classification of a space and issue of an entry permit was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control CONTINUOUS_ATMOSPHERIC_MONITORING: the continuous atmospheric monitoring during occupancy had degraded below its design intent, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

Control GAS_TEST_BEFORE_AND_DURING_HOT_WORK: the atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STANDBY_ATTENDANCE_AND_RESCUE: the standby attendance and non-entry rescue capability was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the classification of a space and issue of an entry permit on PSV-4111 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work on PSV-4111 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in authorising and controlling entry, specifically standby attendance and entry logging. PSV-4111 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during shift handover while the classification of a space and issue of an entry permit was not in place. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 20 February 2018 an incident occurred on PSV-4111 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during shift handover, releasing chemical energy held as hydrocarbon.
